name: PdxBulkActions
description:
A contextual action bar for a multi-selection: while items are selected it shows how many, a
button per action and a clear button.

members.name: count
members.description: Number of selected items — drives visibility and the default label.

members.name: label
members.description: Label template; `{count}` is substituted. Default: the `bulk-actions.selected` component string, "{count} selected".

events.name: pdx-action
events.description: An action was pressed; an `aria-disabled` one emits nothing.

events.name: pdx-clear
events.description: The clear button was pressed: the parent clears its selection.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Number of selected items — drives visibility and the default label.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Label template; `{count}` is substituted. Default: the `bulk-actions.selected` component string, "{count} selected".

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: The bar, a `role="toolbar"`, shown while `count` is above 0.
